who-we-are.title: Who we are
who-we-are.text: BajaETS is a student team from École de Technologie Supérieure (ETS) in Montreal, Canada that competes in the Baja SAE competition. The team is comprised of students from various engineering disciplines who come together to design, build, and race an off-road vehicle against other universities from around the world. BajaETS has been participating in the competition since 1989 and has consistently placed well, including several top 10 finishes. The team prides itself on its innovative designs, strong teamwork, and dedication to pushing the limits of off-road racing technology.

research-and-innovation.title: Research and Innovation
research-and-innovation.text: At BajaETS, integrating technology is a top priority. In the 2017 season, we made history as the first team to win using an electronically actuated continuously variable transmission (EVT) that we developed ourselves. This innovation was a game-changer, now patented to B-Cinq Technologies, a company funded by BajaETS alumni. We're proud of our achievement and excited for the future of this technology.

partners.title: Partners
partners.message: We are deeply grateful to our sponsors for their unwavering support and partnership. Their contributions are vital to our success, empowering us to innovate and expand. We'd like to thank them for investing in our future and for being an essential part of our community.

platinum-messages.BRP: BRP is a global leader in powersports, designing and manufacturing innovative off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, and watercraft. Their technical mentorship and material support directly elevate the competitiveness of our vehicle.
platinum-messages.Blaxes: Blaxes Usinage CNC specializes in manufacturing high-precision machined parts out of Sherbrooke. Their expertise in complex 5-axis machining helps Baja ÉTS save precious grams on the vehicle.
platinum-messages.ETS: The École de technologie supérieure emphasizes hands-on engineering training, providing unparalleled support to student clubs. Baja ÉTS relies on the school's resources and dedication to achieve its competitive goals.
platinum-messages.SKF: SKF is a world leader in bearings and associated technologies, serving industries from automotive to aerospace. They provide Baja ÉTS with technical guidance and high-quality bearing solutions for our vehicle.
platinum-messages.EngrenageLB: Engrenage LB has specialized in precision machining of custom parts since 1996, known for meticulous attention to detail. They supply Baja ÉTS with high-quality gears and critical drivetrain components.
platinum-messages.Altium: Altium Designer is a premier PCB design suite offering advanced tools for schematic capture, layout, and simulation. It empowers Baja ÉTS to design the intricate and reliable circuit boards that drive our systems.
platinum-messages.RessortsLiberte: Ressorts Liberté is a leading manufacturer of high-precision springs for commercial and recreational applications. They enable Baja ÉTS to produce springs tailored to our vehicle's suspension geometry.
platinum-messages.OSG: OSG manufactures high-performance cutting tools including taps, drills, and end mills for precision machining. Their equipment enables Baja ÉTS to produce the critical components that drive our vehicle's performance.
platinum-messages.AEETS: The Association Étudiante de l'ÉTS (AEETS) represents and supports the student body at École de technologie supérieure. Their funding and advocacy empower student clubs like Baja ÉTS to thrive and compete at the highest level.

partners.message-short: We are deeply grateful to our sponsors for their unwavering support and partnership.
